data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 inherits the digit-allocation procedure of SRC_002: both compute D(n)=9×1+90×2+(n−99)×3=792, differing only in that SRC_006 iterates the mechanism forward (189 consumed, then 201 allocated) whereas SRC_002 allocates exhaustively. It is REFUTED IF an earlier source introduces a step-function D(n) incompatible with the piecewise-linear digit-usage formula shared by both, or if SRC_006 omits the base-10 carry boundary that makes the segment allocation exact.
